Messages.Author: Roger Carhult
Messages.Body:
What happens if multiple Life boons are played on same Methuselah?
I.e. Player #1 LB's player #2 and then some rounds later player #2 is
ousted and player #5 LB's player #2. Then player #2 ousts player #3,
who gets the VP? I'd guess player #1 and then if player #2 ousts
player #4 player #5 gets that VP. Is this correct?

As for Courier, if I bleed someone successfully with the Courier, can
I use the same Courier's ability to look at the top card of the
library, eventhough he is tapped and cannot discard it? (I'd assume so
but want to be sure).

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Roger Carhult wrote:
> What happens if multiple Life boons are played on same Methuselah?

They queue up for VPs that that player gets.
google: "multiple life boons author:LSJ"

> I.e. Player #1 LB's player #2 and then some rounds later player #2 is
> ousted and player #5 LB's player #2. Then player #2 ousts player #3,
> who gets the VP? I'd guess player #1 and then if player #2 ousts
> player #4 player #5 gets that VP. Is this correct?

Yes.

> As for Courier, if I bleed someone successfully with the Courier, can
> I use the same Courier's ability to look at the top card of the
> library, eventhough he is tapped and cannot discard it? (I'd assume so
> but want to be sure).

Yes.
